svg.title: Compare Commission Yield, Not Equipment Value
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-equipment-subniche-commission-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Commission Yield, Not Equipment Value; subtitle: Five illustrative sub-niche yields use the same $100,000 sale denominator.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are commission percentages, not dollars, net margins, or published market averages. Each bar assumes a $100,000 equipment sale solely to isolate yield. Actual commission schedules depend on mandate scope and negotiation; these bars do not replace canonical annual scenarios.; caption: At a common $100,000 sale value, an 8% commission earns $8,000 and a 3% commission earns $3,000. Compare inspection effort, sales-cycle length, claim exposure, and collection reliability before choosing a niche. Escrow protects settlement mechanics; it does not establish equipment condition.; stages: label: Specialized industrial equipment; value: 8% illustrative yield earns eight thousand dollars; numeric value: 8.0; detail: Assume a scarce, specification-sensitive asset with a narrow buyer pool. Verify utilities, controls, guarding, and removal scope; higher assumed commission yield can be consumed by specialist diligence and slow matching.; label: CNC machine tools; value: 6% illustrative yield earns six thousand dollars; numeric value: 6.0; detail: Require serial-specific configuration, controller and spindle evidence, service records, and independent condition review. This 6% assumption also supports the separate Base funnel's $250,000 average equipment sale.; label: Heavy construction equipment; value: 5% illustrative yield earns five thousand dollars; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Check hour-meter consistency, hydraulic condition, undercarriage wear, attachment ownership, and lien exposure. Document inspection limits where equipment cannot be tested under working load.; label: Warehouse and material-handling assets; value: 4% illustrative yield earns four thousand dollars; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Verify rated capacity, mast configuration, battery condition, charger inclusion, and service evidence. Separate broker compensation from freight and loading charges paid directly to service providers.; label: Commercial fleet vehicles; value: 3% illustrative yield earns three thousand dollars; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Check VIN, certificate of title, recorded lienholder, mileage evidence, and state dealer or broker licensing requirements. Reject payment from an unrelated party until identity and transaction purpose are resolved.

rect.title: label: Specialized industrial equipment; value: 8% illustrative yield earns eight thousand dollars; numeric value: 8.0; detail: Assume a scarce, specification-sensitive asset with a narrow buyer pool. Verify utilities, controls, guarding, and removal scope; higher assumed commission yield can be consumed by specialist diligence and slow matching.

label: CNC machine tools; value: 6% illustrative yield earns six thousand dollars; numeric value: 6.0; detail: Require serial-specific configuration, controller and spindle evidence, service records, and independent condition review. This 6% assumption also supports the separate Base funnel's $250,000 average equipment sale.

label: Heavy construction equipment; value: 5% illustrative yield earns five thousand dollars; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Check hour-meter consistency, hydraulic condition, undercarriage wear, attachment ownership, and lien exposure. Document inspection limits where equipment cannot be tested under working load.

label: Warehouse and material-handling assets; value: 4% illustrative yield earns four thousand dollars; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Verify rated capacity, mast configuration, battery condition, charger inclusion, and service evidence. Separate broker compensation from freight and loading charges paid directly to service providers.

label: Commercial fleet vehicles; value: 3% illustrative yield earns three thousand dollars; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Check VIN, certificate of title, recorded lienholder, mileage evidence, and state dealer or broker licensing requirements. Reject payment from an unrelated party until identity and transaction purpose are resolved.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are commission percentages, not dollars, net margins, or published market averages. Each bar assumes a $100,000 equipment sale solely to isolate yield. Actual commission schedules depend on mandate scope and negotiation; these bars do not replace canonical annual scenarios.
